name: gc-minimal-ip-doodle
title_zh: 把IP角色重绘成极简手绘贴纸批量包
tagline_zh: 角色还是那个角色，但变成白底颗粒上的冷淡简笔画。一次来五张不同生活场景，张张不重样，像手账贴纸一样耐看。
tagline_en: Same character, redrawn as deadpan flat doodles on grainy white. Five varied scenes per batch, no repeats—like.
desc_en: Preserve an IP character's identity while redrawing it as a sparse, flat, hand-drawn sticker illustration on white or a light grainy background. Use for requests such as "把这个角色做成极简手绘风格", "生成五张不同生活场景", "做一个浅色背景轻颗粒版", "再来五张不要重复", or when a frog, capybara, fish, mascot, toy, or other character reference must become a consistent batch of cute deadpan doodles.
why_zh: 它锁住身份特征再降维，不是换皮。稀疏线条+轻颗粒背景是固定配方，批量生成时靠场景差异撑变化，呆萌感不散。
why_en: It locks identity cues first, then strips to sparse lines on grainy white. Scene variation drives the batch, so deadpan charm.
limit_zh: 只吃单一角色参考图，多角色同框会糊。输出是扁平贴纸风，不接厚涂、3D或写实。背景只认白或浅颗粒，深色底直接罢工。
limit_en: Single-character reference only; group shots blur. Output is flat sticker style—no painterly, 3D, or realistic. White or light grain background.
